title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 16 November 1976.

On this day, the 11th of 13 mixing sessions, the songs ‘Silly Love Songs’, ‘Beware My Love’, and ‘Letting Go’ were worked on.

‘Silly Love Songs’ was recorded on 25 May 1976 at New York’s Madison Square Garden. ‘Beware My Love’ was from 7 June 1976 at McNichols Sports Arena in Denver, and ‘Letting Go’ was taped on 29 May 1976 at Kemper Arena in Kansas City.
